history.summary: Plan r1 is complete and committed: seven phases across Ansible, PrometheusDeploy, DockerImages and ElasticsearchDeploy, 14 acceptance criteria, the DHCP probe's reply path witnessed live from srviac, and two before-run operator actions. Two operator questions in plan_questions_r1.md: Ruling D2's unscoped LoadBalancer alert would page 42 times for stopped KubeCoder environments, and the runbook confirmation needs the deployed reader plus permission to read its OpenBao password.
